_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Shows product identity, candidate variants, checked offers and observed-price comparability. Keep unresolved identities and unknown shipping explicit.

description: Checks an offer using a BestPrice product URL, a reviewed merchant URL, a barcode, or visible product text from a screenshot. Screenshot inputs consist of visible identity text and an optional observed price. Unique barcodes and reviewed variant-identifying URLs can establish an exact identity. Text queries return candidates for explicit user selection; similarity does not establish an exact retailer match. Compares current eligible offers and known delivered totals separately from market item-price history. Observed prices remain user-supplied, missing variants and former prices remain unverified, and unknown shipping remains unknown. Read-only; no checkout or alerts.

observed_price.description: Price visibly supplied by the shopper. Never infer a price or an advertised former price.

amount.description: The observed offer amount in EUR.

basis.description: Whether the observed amount excludes shipping or includes it.

postal_code.description: Optional user-supplied Greek delivery postcode (10000 to 85999). Unknown shipping remains unknown.

product_id.description: An exact returned candidate the user explicitly selected; does not prove it matches a retailer listing.

query.description: Visible brand/model/variant text or a barcode. Text retrieval returns candidates, not a proven retailer identity.

url.description: HTTPS product URL from BestPrice or a merchant. Credentials and alternate ports are unsupported.

name: check_deal

__schema0.description: Result schema version. Currently 2.0; a later <major>.<minor> is returned without a tools/list change.

__schema11.description: Signed, anonymous id joining this recommendation to its BestPrice landing and outbound-click telemetry.

__schema15.description: The ranking actually applied, including the one resolved when the request omitted objective.

__schema16.description: Catalog lowest listed item price in EUR before shipping. Same identity as search_products.price_from. Not a buyable quote.

__schema17.description: Lowest quoted item_price among the returned offers after public filters; distinct from the indicative catalog_price_from.

__schema18.description: Lowest delivered total among returned offers with known shipping; null when none are known.

anyOf.description: Why catalog_price_from is absent from the returned page. Null when the catalog min is quoted or the page is cheaper. Known values: promoted, not_in_stock, missing_merchant, filtered, not_on_page, omitted_from_offer_list, no_catalog_price. New values are added without a tools/list change.

availability.description: Offer availability; treat an unrecognized value as unknown. Known values: in_stock, delivery_1_3_days, delivery_4_7_days, delivery_4_10_days, delivery_8_14_days, by_order, to_order, preorder, out_of_stock, unknown. New values are added without a tools/list change.

certification_level.description: BestPrice certification tier of the store (php/classes/Merchant.php verification_level 1..4); null when not certified.

condition.description: Item condition; treat an unrecognized value as unknown. Known values: new, refurbished, used, open_box, unknown. New values are added without a tools/list change.

item_price.description: Current item price in EUR before shipping.

merchant_logo_raster_url.description: PNG or JPEG logo of the store on the same CDN; null when the store has no logo.

merchant_logo_url.description: BestPrice CDN SVG logo of the store; null when the store has none.

price_anomaly.description: below_peer_price_range: item price is below 40% of the median of at least two other eligible offers. This listing remains inspectable but requires verification and is excluded from recommendations. Null means this peer-price check did not flag it; it is not a guarantee of price accuracy.

price_checked_at.description: When BestPrice retrieved this quote, not the merchant feed update time or a guarantee that the merchant price has not changed.

shipping_price.description: Known or estimated shipping price in EUR; null means unknown.

shipping_unknown_cause.description: Why shipping is unknown: missing when the store published no usable shipping cost, invalid when it published one this service refuses to trust. Null whenever shipping_status is known or estimated.

total_price.description: Item price plus published shipping in EUR; null whenever shipping is unknown. Floor delivery, installation, old-appliance removal, payment fees and additional remote-area charges are not verified by this quote.

verified_merchant.description: True when this is a BestPrice-certified store (Πιστοποιημένο κατάστημα).

anyOf.description: Non-null anomaly codes require verification and exclude the listing from recommendations; treat unknown codes conservatively. Known values: below_peer_price_range. New values are added without a tools/list change.

match_basis.description: Relevance method behind match_confidence. Currently catalog_relevance_token_coverage_v1; a revised method is returned as a new <name>_v<N> id without a tools/list change.

match_confidence.description: Deterministic relative relevance hint based on token coverage and rank; not a probability or feature verification.

match_relationship.description: Deterministic relationship to a requested named model. exact_product covers requested identity tokens and variant qualifiers; it does not certify features. Unknown codes carry no identity assurance. Known values: exact_product, variant, accessory, related_product. New values are added without a tools/list change.

price_from.description: Catalog lowest listed item price in EUR before shipping. Indicative catalog minimum rather than a buyable quote; it may originate from a promoted, out-of-stock, or filtered offer. It has a different basis from returned offer quotes.

rating.description: BestPrice shopper rating for this product: average of count first-party ratings. Null when the product has none.

amount.description: The observed offer amount in EUR.

basis.description: Whether the observed amount excludes shipping or includes it.

candidates.description: Grouped BestPrice products. For a barcode (GTIN) query the text search cannot find, at most the one grouped product that carries exactly that barcode, with a warning saying so; a barcode shared by several products returns none.

deal_classification.description: Classification against the 180-day window statistics, independent of period_days. insufficient_data and unavailable describe evidence limitations; a compatible null supplies no classification.

methodology_id.description: Price-history method. Currently bestprice_daily_min_v1; a revised method is returned as a new <name>_v<N> id without a tools/list change.

price_delta_vs_180d_median_pct.description: Current price versus the 180-day median, in percent. Always 180 days, independent of period_days.

window_stats.description: Minimum and median statistics for the 30-, 90- and 180-day windows, whatever period_days was requested. The canonical result remains available to the model and card; an empty array supplies no window statistics.

title: Check a BestPrice deal
